Your primary failure in this match was vision (6.0 vs 18.2). This is critical because it directly impacts your ability to control the map and set up for objectives, especially given your role as Akshan in the middle lane.

WHAT YOU DID RIGHT  
You had an impressive KDA of 13/1/2 (15.0). This matters because it shows you were able to secure kills while minimizing deaths, which is essential for maintaining pressure and scaling into the mid and late game.

ROLE EXECUTION  
As Akshan MIDDLE, you fulfilled your job of dealing damage and securing kills. However, remember that your role also includes providing vision for your team, especially against hard engage threats like Vi. Don’t confuse your job with that of your support; you need to take the initiative in vision control.

TURNING POINTS  
- First objective setup: You participated in 1 Herald but did not place any control wards. This mattered because without vision, your team was vulnerable to enemy engages. Replay checklist: Were you communicating with your team about vision needs before the Herald fight?  
- First death: Review the circumstances leading to your first death. This is crucial to understand if it was due to overextension or lack of vision. Replay checklist: Did you check for enemy wards or potential ganks before engaging?
